adapter.network: none; the step generates a shim from the tracked template
adapter.note: adapters/installed/* is gitignored (.gitignore:11), so a cold checkout has no adapter and the decompile aborts with 'adapter not installed for hash ...' before writing any artifact. The install step is offline and leaves adapters/manifest.json untouched, because the pinned snapshot hash is already an entry there.

artifacts.manifest_digest_derivation: sha256 over one line per emitted artifact, '<path>\t<bytes>\t<sha256>\n', paths in ascending byte order, no header; see check-compat-baseline.py side_manifest_text and tree_manifest_digest

command.expected_exit_reason: quality gate failed after artifact generation; artifacts complete

revisions.candidate_role: the product-state revision the candidate artifacts were built from, taken as the newest revision whose product tree the artifacts still match. The emitted bytes come from the release build of 2214697, which changed the counter; the only product-path change between that commit and this one is crates/flutterdec-decompiler/tests/unresolved_cf_accounting.rs, a test-only file the release binary does not compile. It is deliberately not advanced to later docs-only commits: advancing it would silently change what the artifacts are claimed to come from. What has to stay true is that the product tree has not moved since, which candidate_product_tree_sha256 pins and check-compat-baseline.py verify enforces against the current HEAD.
revisions.evidence_provenance: the prose document and every file in docs/compat-evidence/ are committed by docs-only commits that come after the candidate revision, so the revision that delivers this evidence cannot be recorded here: a commit cannot contain its own hash. Read it from the repository instead - 'git log --oneline -- docs/compat-baseline-real-binary.md docs/compat-evidence/' - and note that those commits touch no product_tree_paths, which is the property verify checks.
revisions.product_tree_derivation: sha256 over one '<path>\t<git blob object id>\n' line per tracked file under product_tree_paths, paths in ascending byte order, no header; see check-compat-baseline.py product_tree_digest

semantic_adjudication.modes: derive and check need both output trees; verify and --self-test are offline

toolchain.nix_config_note: needed on a host whose nix.conf does not already enable the two experimental features; without it the `nix develop` build line and scripts/ci-check.sh both fail with "experimental Nix feature 'nix-command' is disabled" before anything is built

volatile_fields.note: the three workspace-dependent strings in report.json: the input path and two absolute paths under the repository root. report-*.json in this directory store them as "<input>" and "<repo>/...", and `check-compat-baseline.py replay` normalizes them before comparing report.json. Every other emitted byte is stable: a second and a third candidate process reproduced all 17402 artifacts exactly, and a fourth run from a different input path reproduced 17401 of them and differed only in report.json.input.
